name: flask-basecoat
description: Flask extension wrapping the shadcn/ui design system as Jinja macros, with a compliance harness that checks every component against the pinned upstream sources.

scripts.build: npm run build:css && npm run build:package-css
scripts.golden: cd compliance/golden && npx tsx render.tsx && npx @tailwindcss/cli -i golden.css -o out/golden.css --minify
